_what_this_is: The GENERIC shape every custom analytic must fill. Not a list of analytics - a template. Any new analytic asked for tomorrow is described by filling these ten fields. Instances live in blocks/.

_field_guide.name: unique id. POPULATES prompt section 6 (block) and the generated function name stage_<name>
_field_guide.description: one line for humans and for the UI. Never enters a prompt.
_field_guide.requires: semantic tags this block accepts. USED BY edge check condition 1.
_field_guide.requires_fields: fields it needs from upstream. USED BY edge check condition 2. POPULATES prompt section 6 (must read).
_field_guide.frames: 1 = current only, 2 = previous and current, n = bounded window. DETERMINES THE FUNCTION SIGNATURE.
_field_guide.state: none | per_track | global. none is generatable; the others need a state object passed by reference.
_field_guide.libraries: [] means C++14 standard library only. POPULATES prompt section 3 (allow-list).
_field_guide.emits: semantic tag this block produces. USED BY edge check when this block feeds another.
_field_guide.provides: fields this block puts in its event. POPULATES prompt section 6 (must fill). THIS IS THE INTERFACE FOR THE NEXT BLOCK.
_field_guide.params: config, name -> C++ type. POPULATES prompt section 6 (params) and the config struct.
_field_guide.rule: ONE sentence, plain English. POPULATES prompt section 6 (RULE). This is the only free text the model sees.
_field_guide.skeleton: filename under templates/. POPULATES prompt section 7.

_how_to_add_a_new_analytic: 3. write templates/<your_name>.txt - the signature plus numbered TODOs, ending mid-function with NO closing brace
4. run the edge check against the upstream event you intend to use
5. nothing else changes - the prompt builder and edge checker read the registry
